app.name: PvZ Portable
app.long_description:
A community-driven reimplementation of Plants vs. Zombies: Game of the Year Edition.
This package does NOT include any game assets. Copy main.pak and the properties/ folder from your own legally purchased copy of PvZ GOTY Edition into sd:/apps/PvZPortable/.
The game must be installed on the SD card; it always loads its data and saves from sd:/apps/PvZPortable/.
Source: github.com/Mug-Costanza/PvZ-Portable-Wii-U Based on: github.com/wszqkzqk/PvZ-Portable
